svg.text: Squares in a circle — fit of r(n) = sqrt(n/pi) + C + D/sqrt(n)
dots: best-known packings n=1..50 (upper bounds, truncated decimals). star: check point n=68, r=5.031405 (construction, not a fit input)
B. excess over the leading term
Holdout (train 1..H, predict H+1..50): bias -0.015..-0.033, rmse 0.023..0.035 — forward extrapolation is systematically LOW,
so the -0.014..-0.032 miss at n=68 is model-inherent. y_68 is inside the observed band (z=+1.26): check passes but has no resolving power at +/-0.023 scatter.
